programme.title: Andromeda: Fortiden er uendelig
programme.desc: Harper opdager et program, der kan ødelægge otte af Seefra-planeterne og dræbe millioner af mennesker.

programme.title: Andromeda: Modsætningerne af tiltrækning
programme.desc: Mens Harper arbejder på en måde at redde Seefra-systemet på, sniger en spion sig om bord på Andromeda og angriber Beka.

programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endnu en dags lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhængere om, at den forestående ødelæggelse af de ydre planeter er et komplot, der skal gøre det lettere for dem at plyndre deres planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stilheden i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka arbejder sammen for at redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 1)
programme.desc: Besætningen når endelig ud af Seefra-systemet og opdager, at Dylan er den sidste Paradine

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 2)
programme.desc: Den endelige kamp for at redde det nye systemers Commonwealth begynder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under the Night
programme.desc: Efter at være strandet nær et sort hul bliver kaptajn Dylan Hunt opdaget af et bjærgningsskib og finder ud af, at han har været frosset i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekræftende flamme
programme.desc: Dylan beskytter Andromeda mod lejesoldater, mens Beka begynder at spekulere på, om de kæmper for den forkerte side.

programme.title: Andromeda: At miste det skæbnesvangre lyn
programme.desc: Dylan finder en rumstation fuld af børn, som tror, at han er der for at skabe fred ved at dræbe deres fjender.

programme.title: Andromeda: D Minus Zero
programme.desc: Andromeda-besætningen er stadig ved at lære at arbejde sammen, da de bliver angrebet af Restorers.

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: Lethe-bankerne
programme.desc: Et sort hul giver Dylan mulighed for at kommunikere med sin tidligere forlovede 300 år tilbage i tiden.

programme.title: Andromeda: En rose i asken
programme.desc: Dylan er fængslet på en fængselsplanet og må arrangere en flugt, mens hans besætning forsøger at redde dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Hele Neptuns store hav
programme.desc: Castalianere går om bord på Andromeda for at færdiggøre charteret for det nye Commonwealth. Da lederen bliver fundet død, er Tyr den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: Andromeda: Perlerne, der var hans øjne
programme.desc: Beka finder ud af, at hendes fars tidligere forretningspartner handler med et stærkt vanedannende stof kaldet F lash

programme.title: Andromeda: Tårernes matematik
programme.desc: Andromeda opdager sit søsterskib, Pax Magellanic. Besætningen om bord på Pax er 300 år gammel... men er ikke blevet ældre en eneste dag.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well-liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: In 2007, Brian and Beverly Mauck were found dead in their Graham, Washington home. Using a bloody palm print and shoe prints at the scene, investigators focus their attention on Daniel Tavares, who had previously inked a tattoo on Brian's back.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shoe-In For Murder
programme.desc: On May 12, 1994, Crystal Perry was viciously murdered in her home in Bridgton, Maine. Michael Hutchinson, 32, was later found guilty in the slaying.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Interrupted
programme.desc: The gunman opened fire as the family of four entered their home. He’d pulled open a few drawers to make it look like a robbery, but the scene was clearly staged. When police pieced together the clues, they discovered an unlikely suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Runaway Love
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19, was convicted of stabbing her mother, Barbara Mullenix, in 2006. She allegedly packed her mother's bloodied corpse in a cardboard box before dumping it in California's Newport Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Watchful Eye
programme.desc: On May 20, 2001, Carrie Nelson was beaten to death while working alone in a park office. The case went unsolved for six years. Finally, police found a match with DNA samples gathered from the crime scene.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Little Secret
programme.desc: Police get a clue about a couple who disappeared on Memorial Day weekend during an in-progress robbery. The evidence found solves a brutal crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Lights Out
programme.desc: In this episode, the decade-old murder of a young Texas housewife is investigated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pet Rock
programme.desc: In 1995, Palm Beach waitress Denise O'Neill is abducted and murdered. Her neighbor Luis Caballero arouses suspicions by behaving oddly towards TV crews covering the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Best Foot Forward
programme.desc: In 2007, Shamaia Smith disappears from a strip club in East Hartford, CT. Police consider various patrons of the club but focus on local businessman Kenneth Otto.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hell's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Kristine Fitzhugh failed to show up for her music class, her husband found her dead at the bottom of the stairs of their Palo Alto home. Further investigation reveals evidence of murder in the kitchen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: In 1999, Susan Fassett was gunned down as she left her church choir practice in Poughkeepsie, NY. After clearing her husband, police turned their attention to Fred Andros, with whom Susan had an affair.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Squire's Riches
programme.desc: Responding to a 2008 garage fire, Illinois emergency response discovered a man crushed beneath a truck.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Freeze Framed
programme.desc: In 2005, David Castor suffered a slow, agonizing death over a period of days. His wife maintained it was suicide, even though it was done with antifreeze.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Touch of Evil
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the media dubbed Richard Rogers the "Last Call Killer" because he targeted men in gay bars who were obviously intoxicated.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Abroad
programme.desc: Beginning in 1990, Europe found itself in the clutches of a serial killer. He became an international outlaw, hopping from country to country to evade capture and to kill again.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Moving Target
programme.desc: When a sniper in Utah started targeting African-American men for death, authorities launched a massive investigation. With scant clues and no witnesses they found the odds stacked against them, and they had no idea where the killer would strike next.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Mission
programme.desc: When a family was murdered in Arkansas, it seemed like an isolated event. But soon the crime was revealed to be part of an ever-widening circle of violence that defined a new age of domestic terrorism.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cop Killer
programme.desc: In 1995, our nation's capital was also our nation's murder capital. Even the police weren't safe. While Washington, DC, law enforcement targeted criminals, the criminals targeted law enforcement, even gunning down officers on patrol.

programme.title: The FBI Files: .22 Caliber Killer
programme.desc: In Buffalo, New York, a sniper targeted African-American men. He held a city hostage, and threatened to ignite a racial powder keg. And it looked like others might be following his bloody example.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Proof Of Innocence
programme.desc: DNA analysis overturns the convictions of three men who have spent years behind bars, paying for crimes they did not commit.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stranger Than Fiction
programme.desc: A millionaire is found dead, murdered for a stash of buried silver. A young woman dates violent men, only to be killed by her best friend.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In the Camera's Eye
programme.desc: Photography has long been a vital tool in homicide investigations. A single image captures enough information to identify a suspect, and to preserve a vital clue long after a witness' memory fades.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Collective Justice
programme.desc: Philadelphia's Vidocq Society, named after an 18th Century French detective, is one of the world's most unusual crime-solving organizations.

programme.title: The Hills: A Date With The Past
programme.desc: Gammel kærlighed blusser op da Stephen Coletti dukker op i Laurens liv igen. Heidi prøver at sørge for, at Stephanie ikke kommer til Laurens housewarming.

programme.title: The Hills: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Lauren har svært ved at vælge side, da problemerne mellem Lo og Audrina eskalerer. Og Heidi tager et job, der vil tage hende til Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Hills: The Next Move Is Yours
programme.desc: I sæsonens sidste afsnit føler Audrina sig lukket ude af Laurens venskab med Lo, og hun overvejer at flytte ud. Lauren gør et sidste forsøg på at blive god venner med Audrina, men måske er det for sent.

programme.title: The Hills: We'll Never Be Friends
programme.desc: Da sæson fire starter er situationen mellem Audrina og Lo anspændt. Lauren forsøger at gøre et godt indtryk på en ny fyr, og et besøg fra Heidis søster Holly truer Spencer og Heidis forhold.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love

programme.desc: De har kun en chance tilbage for at vinde, og ikke flere kort på hånden, så alle må stole på, at de seks følger deres hjerte og vælger deres perfekte match. Amber er fanget mellem tre mulige partnere.

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1
programme.desc: Kærligheden slår straks gbister, da 22 singler fra hele verden flytter ind i et hus på De Kanariske Øer for at se, om de kan finde deres perfekte match og vinde 1 million dollars.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1

programme.title: Are You The One?: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2
programme.desc: En nat går et par fra hinanden og går videre til nye forhold, mens andre par tror, de har fundet 'den ene'. Der er tryk på, da romantiske forbindelser bliver sat på prøve ved den første Match Up-ceremoni.
programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Awkward: Most Awkward Moments
programme.desc: Pinlige øjeblikke venter, når vi tager et kig på de bedste klip fra 'Awkward', hvor skuespillerne selv kommenterer de sjoveste replikker, de saftigste forhold og meget mere fra deres yndlingsafsnit af 'Awkward'.

programme.title: Awkward: Prank Amateurs
programme.desc: En række pranks skaber kaos og Jennas forsæt om at holde op med at tænke på Matty bliver sat på prøve, da hun overhører en chokerende hemmelighed.

programme.title: Awkward: Short Circuit Party
programme.desc: Jenna er skyld i en ulykke på skolen, som får overraskende følger. Samtidig må Matty håndtere konsekvenserne af konfrontationen med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna In Wonderland
programme.desc: Mens Jenna nyder lidt popularitet, har Matty det svært med at blive holdt uden for. Samtidig bager Jake på den nye pige, og Ally holder en sexlege-fest.

programme.title: Awkward: Now You See Me, Now I Don't
programme.desc: Årbøgerne er kommet ud. Jenna bliver helt nede over stikordet under hendes billede, men hvad vil Matty skrive i hendes årbog?
programme.sub-title: Now You See Me, Now I Don't

programme.title: Awkward: The Dis-Engagement Dinner
programme.desc: Jenna tvinges til at holde en fest for Tamara for at fejre hendes falske forlovelse. Samtidig får Jenna en hemmelighed at vide om Matty, der sender hende ud på en jagt efter sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Don't Dream It's Over
programme.desc: Da Tamara siger, at Jenna ødelægger forhold, konfronterer Jenna sine ekskærester med overraskende resultater.

programme.title: Awkward: The Big Reveal
programme.desc: Jenna vil afsløre sandheden for Matty, men vil hendes nærmeste stoppe hende?

programme.title: Awkward: An Indecent Promposal
programme.desc: Eleverne inviterer hinanden til bal, og Jenna får nogle overraskende nyheder.

programme.title: Awkward: Say No To The Dress
programme.desc: Jenna har bestemt sig for at få det perfekte bal, men der er mange forhindringer i vejen.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Does Not Bite
programme.desc: Skoleballet byder på mange overraskelser.

programme.title: Awkward: The Graduates
programme.desc: Eksamensfesten kan blive ødelagt, da Sadie fået et forbud mod at gå hente sit bevis.

programme.title: Awkward: Holding on and Letting Go
programme.desc: Alle prøver at få den sidste aften på skolen til at blive noget særligt.

programme.title: Awkward: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College
programme.desc: Jenna er på toppen af verden, da hun kommer hjem fra sit første år på college, men hendes nye selvtillid rystes, da hun opdager, at hun ikke er den eneste, som har forandret sig.
programme.sub-title: I'm the Kind of Girl Who Found Her Voice in College

programme.title: Awkward: WTF Happened Last Year?
programme.desc: Jenna afslører, hvad der skete med hende og resten af slænget i året der gik - hvad der var grunden til det kølige forhold mellem Matty og Jenna, hvad der startede venskabet mellem Sadie og Tamara og hvordan Jake og Lissa fandt romantikken.

programme.title: Awkward: The Friend Connection
programme.desc: Jenna undgår et nyt forhold for at få kontakt med dem, hun arbejder sammen med. Imens holder Tamara en chik fødselsdagsfest for Sadie - som efterlader mere end en festdeltager i dårligt festhumør.

programme.title: Awkward: Best Friends For Never
programme.desc: I et forsøg på at gøre Idea Bin til et hyggeligere sted for hende selv, skaffer Jenna en praktikplads til Tamara, men opdager hurtigt, det kan være katastrofalt at arbejde med venner.

programme.title: Awkward: Fireworks
programme.desc: Jake giver Jenna og Tamara vagter i country-klubben den 4. juli, men Sullys planer om en efterfest på golfbanen resulterer i et dramatisk fyrværkeri.

programme.title: Awkward: Digging Deep
programme.desc: Efter en sjov 4. juli, fortsætter Jenna og Matty med at fyre op under venskabet ved at holde fest for Jake - i det mindste indtil Jennas nyeste Idea Bin-post truer med at afsløre alt.

programme.title: Awkward: Girls Gone Viral
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at vælge mellem succes hos Idea Bin og sit venskab med Matty. Jake oplever et uventet intimt møde, og Sadie og Sergio afslører pludselig mere end nogensinde før.

programme.title: Awkward: Misadventures in Babysitting
programme.desc: Jenna melder sig som barnepige og modtager uventet hjælp af Matty. Imens får Lissa at vide, hvad der er hemmeligheden ved at være en Palos Hills-mor, og Tamara og Sadie får mere end nok til en rig teenagers strandfest.

programme.title: Awkward: Living in Sin
programme.desc: Jenna tager forholdet med Luke et nyt niveau og Tamaras gæld kommer tilbage og bider hende i halen.

programme.title: Awkward: Home Again, Home Again
programme.desc: Et skænderi med Luke presser Jenna til at tage med til lejrgenforeningen og dermed mod at genoptage kontakten med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Second Chances
programme.desc: Luke hjælper Jenna med at få et vigtigt møde på SCU, Tamara er ærlig over for Patrick om sine pengeproblemer, og Matty får Sadies hjælp til at komme ind i varmen igen hos Lacey.

programme.title: Awkward: Happy Campers, Happier Trails
programme.desc: Jenna må vælge mellem et vigtigt SCU-event og lejrgenforeningen, noget der fører til et endnu større valg: Luke eller Matty. Men hun er ikke alene, for både Jake, Tamara og Lissa må også tage afgørende valg.

programme.title: Awkward: Pilot
programme.desc: Det går fra slemt til rigtig slemt for Jenna Hamilton, når et mystisk brev får alle til at tro, at hun har forsøgt at begå selvmord. Jenna foretager nogle store ændringer i sit liv snarere end at lade sin nye identitet definere hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Knocker Nightmare
programme.desc: Sadie og Lissa sms'er et nøgenfoto af Jenna i pigernes omklædningsrum til hele skolen. Ud over latterliggørelse og sladder får spøgen nogle overraskende reaktioner fra Jennas store forelskelse Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: The Way We Weren't
programme.desc: Jenna undrer sig over, om Matt vil stå frem med deres forhold, da han inviterer hende til en fest. Jenna indser også, at hun måske har mere til fælles med Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: The Scarlet Eye
programme.desc: Jenna vil definere sit forhold til Matty, men er bekymret for, at hun risikerer at miste ham. Imens nyder Tamara sin første sexskandale efter hun fik øjenbetændelse i en heftig omgang i et boblebad.

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Welcome to Collinwood
programme.desc: Cosimo får en plan for et kæmpe job af sin cellekammerat. Han beder sin kvinde om at finde en patsy for sit forkludrede biltyveri og tilbyder 15.000 dollars. Pludselig er 7 involveret.

programme.title: Everything Must Go
programme.desc: Nicolas (Will Ferrell) har en ufatteligt dårlig dag: Han mister sit job, og konen låser ham ude og smider alle hans ting ud af huset. Som en absurd modstandskamp sætter han alle sine ting til salg i et stort loppemarked i forhaven.

programme.title: Film Stars Don't Die in Liverpool
programme.desc: 'Film Stars Don’t Die in Liverpool' er baseret på Peter Turners selvbiografi og følger det livfulde og passionerede forhold mellem Turner (Bell) og den excentriske, Oscar-belønnede skuespiller Gloria Grahame (Bening) i Liverpool i 1978.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: Los Angeles 2028. Hotel Artemis er et hemmeligt og eksklusivt hospital for kriminelle medlemmer.

programme.title: Café Society
programme.desc: New York i 1930’erne. Bobby har brug for luftforandring og er desperat for at komme væk fra sine emsige forældre, sin gangsterbror og familiens juvelerforretning. Bobby beslutter sig for at prøve lykken i Hollywood.

programme.title: Man On The Moon
programme.desc: Den legendariske komiker Andy Kaufmans liv og karriere.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: 1941, syv krigsfanger flygter fra den frygtelige sovjetisk Gulag-lejr. Igennem 11 måneder kæmper de sig over 6.500 km fra Sibirien over den glohede Gobi-ørken i Mongoliet og videre over Himalaya- bjergene.

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: Lars and The Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom er en elskelig indadvendt mand, hvis emotionelle bagage har afholdt ham fra at udforske livet. Efter flere års ensomhed inviterer han Bianca, en ven han har mødt på internettet. Han introducerer Bianca for sin bror, Gus og hans kone, Karen.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
programme.desc: advarsel: den her helt nye film indeholder materiale, der aldrig er set før, det er ubeskåret, skandaløst og aldeles upassende! bad grandpa .5 giver dig et helt nyt syn på irving zismans verden med utrolige bonusscener og morsomme tossestreger.

programme.title: The Rules of engagement
programme.desc: Oberst Terry Childers (Samuel L. Jackson) er en elitesoldat med en pletfri karriere, indtil en rutineoperation i Yemen ender i en katastrofe. Demonstranter foran den amerikanske ambassade går amok og åbner ild.

programme.title: Mean Guns
programme.desc: I stedet for at dræbe sine fjender finder en gangsterleder på en mere kreativ løsning. Han beslutter at spærre dem inde i et fængsel, forsyne dem med våben og lade dem myrde hinanden. Præmien er 10 millioner dollar til de tre sidste overlevende.

programme.title: We Own The Night
programme.desc: To brødre i New York konfronteres med et farligt narkokartel, og deres loyale bånd sættes på prøve i en brutal kamp mellem familie og kriminalitet.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hidden Agenda
programme.desc: Across the Midwest, a band of armed robbers struck banks at the rate of nearly one per month. They attacked with lightning precision and lethal force. They were in and out in five minutes.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Vanished
programme.desc: A daring kidnapping and a bizarre ransom note baffled Mississippi authorities. The victim was the wife of a wealthy businessman. A list of 12 names and a few drops of blood were the only clues to her fate.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Threat
programme.desc: A suspected drug dealer would stop at nothing to keep local and federal authorities from building a case against him. When his organization started targeting the government itself, federal agencies went on high alert.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death In The Delta
programme.desc: When a wealthy young woman was abducted in front of her in-laws' home, the police had no shortage of suspects. The 25-year-old victim left behind a tumultuous marriage, an ex-husband and old boyfriends. All were on the FBI's short list.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Global Pursuit
programme.desc: In Langley, Virginia, a terrorist fired into rush hour traffic. The victims seemed randomly selected, but the motive appeared to be political, targeting employees of the Central Intelligence Agency.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: An armed robbery is a terrifying ordeal. When a gang descended on a Los Angeles cash vault, they threatened to kill anyone who resisted. The violent assault was the largest heist in U.S. history and a piece of plastic was the only evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Surveillance video is often the most precise witness to a crime. After three brutal murders were caught on tape in Alabama, the suspects fled the area. They had an arsenal of stolen weapons, and swore they wouldn't be taken alive.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Den hurtigtsnakkende Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) har udset sig Newage-guruen dr. Sinja. Men efter et mystisk Bodhi-træ dukker op i hans have, indser Jack, at han hellere må forbedre sig, før det sidste blad falder af træet, ellers er han færdig.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Da en hårdtarbejdende redaktør på The New Yorker (Helen Hunt) følger efter sin søn (Brenton Thwaites) til L.A., efter han er droppet ud af college for at finde sig selv, ender hun med selv at være den, der kastes ud i en fuldstændig forvandling.

programme.title: Med Røven I Vandskorpen
programme.desc: Bill Murray spiller hovedrollen som Tripper Harrison, lejrchefen på Camp North Star. Der er masser af sjov og ballade i vente, mens han sammen med lejrens øvrige ledere gør, hvad han kan for at bryde alle regler.

programme.title: Barefoot
programme.desc: En rig families "sorte får" møder en ung psykiatrisk patient, der er vokset op isoleret hele sit liv. Han tager den naive unge kvinde med hjem til sin brors bryllup.

programme.title: Humpday
programme.desc: Det har gået ti år siden Ben og Andrew var skolens 'bad boys' i college. Ben er faldet til ro og har skaffet sig arbejde, kone og villa. Andrew har valgt at gå en anden vej som kringvandrende kunstner. Når Andrew uventet dukker op hos Ben ...

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy, en kendt nyhedsvært i San Diego i 70'erne, mener ikke, at kvinder hører til i nyhedslokalet, så da Ron får en kvik og køn kvindelig kollega, er der dømt krig!

programme.title: Peace, Love & Misunderstanding
programme.desc: Diane er en snerpet advokat fra New York, der netop er blevet vraget af sin mand. I et desperat forsøg på at glemme alt om skilsmissen, tager hun sammen med sine to teenagebørn på en impulsiv weekendtur. Destinationen er en økologisk gård nær Woodstock.

programme.title: Tamara Drewe
programme.desc: Den unge journalist Tama Drewe vender tilbage til sine rødder i en engelsk landsby, for at sælge sit barndomshjem efter sin mors død. Stort drama, på grænsen til tumult, udspiller sig, når nya og gamle bekendtskaber går på jagt efter den ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: Mens hans ægteskab og karriere hænger i en tynd tråd, tager den arbejdsløse forfatter Jack Spencer sammen med sin kone Amanda til et afsides 'glamping'-sted for at finde gnisten igen. Men en overraskende dobbeltbooking...

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Firefight
programme.desc: In Miami, a gang of robbers targeted banks and armored cars. They carried assault weapons and weren't afraid to use them. They struck during the day, and sometimes twice a day. For awhile, they seemed unstoppable.

programme.title: Donal MacIntyre's Murder Files: Lukasz Slaboszewski
programme.desc: Donal MacIntyre interviews Detective Chief Inspector Martin Brunning to discover how the capture of killer Joanna Dennehy led to the discovery of a string of victims.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: Two former California cops go into business in the City of Angels' sleazy adult entertainment industry. But their partnership ends in a murder.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: When a printer refuses to go along with his partner's plans to do business with the mob, the printer is murdered in a contract killing and investigators charge the partner's wife.
programme.sub-title: Phoenix: Shady Deals in Sun City

programme.title: The FBI Files: Family Secrets
programme.desc: A woman and her infant son vanish. The husband is frantic. The clues are scarce, but hopes linger, even as the hours and days tick by without a word. Was she on the run, or the victim of foul play?

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Town
programme.desc: Paula Zahn examines how police raced to track down a vicious killer on his deadly cross-country journey.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Shape of a Killer
programme.desc: 48 Hours is television's most popular true-crime series, investigating shocking cases and compelling real-life dramas with journalistic integrity and cutting-edge style.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The C-11 Squad
programme.desc: New York City is not stranger to gang violence. But when a 12-year-old child was kidnapped, the gangs had crossed a line. Law enforcement raced to find the missing boy before it was too late.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The millionaire residents of a super-wealthy Florida town are stunned when one of the hired help--an exterminator--is accused of murdering a well-known 71-year-old female.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Episode 203 - Counterfeit Sports Memorabilia / Product
programme.desc: In the world of sports memorabilia, counterfeit products can make criminals rich.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: One of the wealthiest doctors in Arkansas finds trouble when she meets a ruthless con man who convinces her to give him more that a million dollars. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

programme.title: Fraud Squad: Fraud Squad.S01E04.Mortgage Fraud & Charity Fraud
programme.desc: A travel agent is sentenced to four years for defrauding over 30 customers out of more than $278,000 in bogus vacation packages.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The colorful story of the ex-cop and curvaceous former Playboy Bunny who was charged with the murder of her husband's ex-wife. After conviction, Lawrencia "Bambi" Bembenek went on the lam.
programme.sub-title: Milwaukee: The Legend Of Bambi Bembenek

programme.title: On the Case: Desperate Cry
programme.desc: A mother's desperate cry for help alerts neighbors and leads to a terrifying discovery.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: St. Augustine, Florida is the oldest city in America. It is a town whose civic pride is matched only by its penchant for easy living.
programme.sub-title: St. Augustine: The Socialite and the Politician

programme.title: On the Case: Murder Ordained?
programme.desc: When a young minister's wife is found dead, it appears to be a tragic accident. But then, another member of the congregation is murdered. Police begin to wonder if its just a coincidence or a calculated plot.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: Detroiters: Quick Rick Mahorn in Dearborn
programme.desc: Tim og Sam opdager, at Chrysler-direktøren, som de kørte over, har haft et forfærdeligt liv lige siden. Efter en optræden i en af fyrenes reklamer, bliver Pistons-legenden Rick Mahorn en seriøs skuespiller.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Worst Generation
programme.desc: Fyrene besøger et plejehjem og møder Adams bedstefar.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Mike DeStefano
programme.desc: Mike DeStefano hjælper sorte med at praje taxier for dem, forklarer hvordan man er en professionel amerikaner og de gode ved stoffer i denne stand-up-special på en halv time.

programme.title: South Park: Cartmans utrolige gave
programme.desc: Et uheldigt forsøg på at flyve bringer Cartman på hospitalet. Da politiet tror, at han har særlige overnaturlige evner for opklarelse af forbrydelser, ansætter de ham til hjælpe med at fange en seriemorder.

programme.title: South Park: Frizone
programme.desc: Cartman bliver offer for body-shaming.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Revenge of Mike Powers

programme.title: South Park: Franchise-forgænger
programme.desc: Facebook er det ultimative våben for Professor Chaos.

programme.title: Workaholics: Fat Cuz

programme.title: South Park: Britneys nye look
programme.desc: Det store mediecirkus ankommer til South Park, da Britney gemmer sig i den afsides bjergby. Drengene prøver at hjælpe den plagede popstjerne.

programme.title: Another Period: Servant's Disease

programme.title: South Park: Ikke sjovt
programme.desc: Cartman er overbevist om, at Butters prøver at stjæle hans kæreste.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans

programme.title: RENO 911!: VHS Transfer Memory Lane
programme.desc: Rizzo and Wiegel pervert-proof the Washoe County Library computers.

programme.title: Workaholics: Bianca Toro
programme.desc: Fyrene prøver at slippe af med en motivationstaler, der blander sig i deres elskede prisuddeling på kontoret.

programme.title: South Park: South Park er homoseksuel!

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Shane Mauss
programme.desc: Shane Mauss diskuterer hullet i hans numse, hvorfor det er kikset med fræk snak og hans problem med metersystemet.

programme.title: Workaholics: Booger Nights
programme.desc: Fyrene er fast besluttede på at være de sjoveste, når en person skal grilles foran alle på kontoret.

programme.title: RENO 911!: The Midnight Swingers

programme.sub-title: Hvad er der blevet af mit land?

programme.desc: Dave debuts Samuel Jackson beer and reveals major upsets in "The Racial Draft."

programme.title: South Park: Kun for medlemmer
programme.desc: Den nyvalgte præsident besøger sin hjemby.

programme.title: Workaholics: The Promotion
programme.desc: Alice hentyder, at nogen skal forfremmes på arbejdet. Anders, Adam og Blake føler, at de fortjener en forfremmelse og konkurrerer om den.

programme.title: South Park: 'Make Love, Not Warcraft'

programme.title: Chappelle's Show: Negrodamus & The Niggar Family
programme.desc: Paul Mooney introduces Negrodamus, and Dave imagines a black Gallagher.

programme.title: South Park: Røde slæde styrtet

programme.title: Workaholics: Model Kombat
programme.desc: Adam prøver at overbevise Alice om at ansætte ham som model til firmaets hjemeside. Alice foretrækker Anders til jobbet, men han vil bevise, at han er 'mere end et ansigt'. Deres konkurrenceiver skaber en rift i deres venskab.

programme.title: Comedy Central Presents: Myq Kaplan
programme.desc: Myq Kaplan kan ikke lide at blive kaldt 'bøssevenlig' og forklarer, hvordan han er en veganer, der ikke kan lide miljøet.

programme.title: RENO 911!: Junior Runs for Office
programme.desc: Junior finds a job he really wants: commissioner for animal carcass removal.

programme.title: South Park: Usikkerhed
programme.desc: Cartman anskaffer sig et nyt sikringssystem til hjemmet.

programme.title: South Park: Mysteriet om de to urinaler
programme.desc: Cartman tror, han ved, hvem der stod bag angrebene den 9/11.

programme.title: South Park: Starvin' Marvin i rummet
programme.desc: Marvin er kommet tilbage! Han og drengene rejser jorden rundt på en mission for at samle mad, skarpt forfulgt af CIA og Sally Struthers.

programme.title: Comedy Central Stand-Up Presents Chris Redd
programme.desc: Chris Redd shares personal stories about a passive-aggressive flight attendant, helping his cousin come out of the closet and meeting a strange magician in Los Angeles.

programme.title: South Park: T.M.I.
programme.desc: Efter en pinlig situation, der involverer visse kropsdele, bliver Cartman send til et kursus i vredeskontrol og Randy gør hvad han kan for at tage sig af efterdønningerne.

programme.title: Workaholics: We Be Ballin'
programme.desc: Adam møder sin 'tredie kærlighed' til en fest. Drengene lyver og siger, at de har billetter til en udsolgt basketballkamp for at imponere hende. Blake ser noget, han ikke burde.

programme.title: South Park: Osama Bin Ladens prutbukser
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet sendt til Afghanistan ved et uheld, kæmper drengene mod Osama og Taliban. De lærer, at de har mere til fælles med de afghanske børn, end de nogensinde havde forestillet sig.

programme.title: South Park: Sjov med kalv
programme.desc: Da drengene kidnapper babykalve for at redde dem fra at blive kalvebøffer, dukker politiet op, hvilket resulterer i en konfrontation.

programme.title: South Park: Ringen
programme.desc: Kenny tager sin nye kæreste med til en Jonas Brothers-koncert, hvor de får kyskhedsringe.

programme.title: South Park: Cykelparade
programme.desc: Drengenes chance for at vinde cykelparaden er i fare, da Kenny dropper ud.

programme.title: South Park: Helen Keller! Musicalen
programme.desc: Drengene laver deres egen produktion af historien om Helen Keller for at overgå børnehavens opførelse.

programme.title: South Park: Scott Tenorman skal dø
programme.desc: Cartman bliver tosset på Scott Tenorman, da den rødhårede Scott narrer vores eftergivende helt til at købe hans kønshår for 16.12 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Katteorgie (del 1)
programme.desc: Shelley er babysitter for Cartman og inviterer sin umulige kæreste til at komme. I mellemtiden er Cartmans kat kommet i løbetid.

programme.title: South Park: Helvede på jord 2006
programme.desc: Det er halloween og Satan arrangerer verdens største kostymebal.

programme.title: South Park: Japanese Toilet
programme.desc: South Park finder ud af, hvor fantastiske japanske toiletter er.

programme.title: South Park: Funnybot
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet gjort grin med til skolens komedie-aften, bygger Tyskland den ultimative grinemaskine: Funnybot. Men dens planer for menneskeheden bliver ikke godt modtaget.

programme.title: South Park: MåneBjørnGris
programme.desc: Mens de hjælper den tidligere vicepræsident Al Gore i hans forsøg på at få opmærksomhed, bliver drengene fanget i en hule. Da de leder efter en udvej, finder Cartman en skat.

programme.title: South Park: Selvgods-alarm!
programme.desc: Folkene i South Park køber hybridbiler. men lige som de er begyndt at glæde sig over at redde jorden, samler en stormende mørk sky sig over byen.

programme.title: South Park: Vulkan
programme.desc: Drengene tager på jagttur med Stan's skøre onkel Jimbo. Men de er ikke klar over, at bjerget, de jager på, er en vulkan, der ved at bryde ud.

programme.title: South Park: Butters' helt eget afsnit
programme.desc: Butter er tilbage med sin helt egen episode! Uforvarende kommer han til at afsløre en mørk familiehemmelighed om sin fars sene 'natteindkøbsture'.

programme.title: South Park: Jødebilæet (del 3)
programme.desc: Da hele South Park venter på, at meteorregnen skal begynde, går Kyle og Ike ud i vildmarken.

programme.title: South Park: Det skøre mishandlingseventyr
programme.desc: Kyle melder sine forældre til politiet for 'mishandling'. Snart anmelder alle børn deres forældre, indtil der kun er børn tilbage i South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Glade hologrammer
programme.desc: Cartmaan Bh trender, da landet forbereder sig på det største juleshow nogensinde.

programme.title: South Park: Vindaloop med stuearrest
programme.desc: Butters er overbevist om, at han lever i en virtuel virkelighed.

programme.title: South Park: Øjenbetændelse
programme.desc: Det er Halloween i South Park, og Kenny bliver slået ihjel af en nedfaldende rumstation og bliver forvandlet til en zombie af noget balsamerende væske, der er forurenet med engelsk sovs.

programme.title: South Park: Hård kristen rock
programme.desc: Cartman er fast besluttet på at opnå et platinum album med sit nye kristne rockband Faith+1.

programme.title: South Park: Befri Willzyx
programme.desc: Drengene besøger Sea World og opdager en talende hval. Uvidende om, at de er udsat for en spøg, forsøger de at returnere hvalen til der, hvor den kom fra, månen.

programme.title: South Park: Spring Break
programme.desc: Forårsferien er Garrisons undskyldning for at genoptage sin depraverede livsstil.

programme.title: South Park: Rejsningsdag
programme.desc: Jimmy er bekymret for, at hans konstante erektion vil forhindre ham i at deltage i talentkonkurrencen og vinde præmien på 1.000 dollar.

programme.title: South Park: Hvad er der blevet af mit land?

programme.sub-title: Hvad er der blevet af mit land?

programme.desc: Cartmann forsøger at rejse ind i fremtiden for at købe et nyt computerspil.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemi
programme.desc: South Park bliver 'Cloverfield', da store, mystiske skabninger begynder at lave ravage rundt om på jorden, indfanget af Randys rystende webcamera.

programme.title: South Park: Handibil
programme.desc: Timmys succes med hans nye bilværksted giver ham en masse fjender.

programme.title: South Park: Coon 2: Tilbageblik

programme.desc: Da Randy lærer hemmeligheden bag musicals at kende kan han ikke lade være med at tage Sharon med til at se dem. Andrew Lloyd-Webber og Elton John advarer ham om ikke at afsløre deres hemmelighed.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Western Air Temple
programme.desc: The gang leaves the Fire Nation, humbled and embarrassed by the failure of the invasion. They head to the Western Air Temple.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Firebending Masters
programme.desc: Aang is ready to start his firebending training. However, as Zuko attempts to teach him, he realizes he has lost all his firebending power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 1
programme.desc: Sokka and Zuko break into The Boiling Rock Prison, the Fire Nation's highest security prison, to rescue Hakoda. When they develope an escape plan after finding Hakoda not there, other prisoners get involved and ruin it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boiling Rock Part 2
programme.desc: This episode is continuing the jailbreak from the previous episode. Sokka, Hakoda, Zuko and Suki form a new escape plan, but it is complicated by the arrival of Princess Azula.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Raiders
programme.desc: Katara and Zuko journey together to find the man responsible for the death of Katara's mother, Kya, who was killed in a Southern Water Tribe raid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Ember Island Players
programme.desc: The gang goes to the theater to see a play about themselves, but are not happy with the production and the inaccurate portrayals of themselves.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King
programme.desc: Aang finds out that Ozai plans to burn down the Earth Kingdom with an airship fleet. He disappears during the night, having sleepwalked onto a mysterious moving island.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 1: The Phoenix King

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters
programme.desc: The gang find Iroh with June's help. Iroh suggests that Zuko challenge Azula for the position of Fire Lord, with Katara to help. The others decide to intercept the airship fleet.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 2: The Old Masters

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno
programme.desc: Sokka, Toph and Suki begin destroying the airship fleet. Aang duels Ozai, but is soon overwhelmed because of his reluctance to kill him.
programme.sub-title: Sozin's Comet Part 3: Into the Inferno

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Sozin's Comet Part 4: Avatar Aang
programme.desc: Katara eventually defeats Azula by trapping her in ice, and heals Zuko. Sokka, Toph and Suki destroy the airship fleet.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Welcome to Republic City
programme.desc: Having mastered water, earth and fire, Avatar Korra is eager to begin her training in airbending, but trouble in Republic City interrupts her plans.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: A Leaf in the Wind
programme.desc: After hitting a snag in her airbending training with Master Tenzin, Korra pays a visit to the city's Pro Bending arena in search of inspiration.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Revelation
programme.desc: Korra attempts to infiltrate the Equalist movement and learn more about its mysterious leader.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Voice in the Night
programme.desc: Korra is recruited to join Councilman Tarrlok's task force, which seeks to rid the city of Equalists by force.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Spirit of Competition
programme.desc: Korra and her pro-bending teammates struggle to work together after romantic rivalries shake their foundation.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: And the Winner Is...
programme.desc: Korra and the Fire Ferrets ready themselves for the pro-bending championship as an evil threat looms over the arena.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Aftermath
programme.desc: Tensions mount when Korra begins to suspect an ally is working for the Equalists.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: When Extremes Meet
programme.desc: Korra faces off with Councilman Tarrlok as Equalist activity continues to rise in Republic City.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Out of the Past
programme.desc: Korra attempts to understand her cryptic visions, while Tenzin and Beifong lead a search for Equalist hostages.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Turning the Tides
programme.desc: The Equalists begin their attack on Republic City.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Skeletons in the Closet
programme.desc: As the war intensifies, Korra goes undercover and discovers a secret about the anti-bending revolution. Meanwhile, her teammates hunt down an Equalist stronghold.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Endgame
programme.desc: In the season finale, Korra faces the mysterious leader of the Equalists as the war in Republic City comes to a head.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Rebel Spirit
programme.desc: Korra struggles to find a deeper connection with the Spirit World as she and the gang attend a Southern Water Tribe festival.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Southern Lights
programme.desc: Korra and Chief Unalaq journey into a dangerous maelstrom and find a source of great spiritual power.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Civil Wars Part 1
programme.desc: While tensions flare between the Northern and Southern Water Tribes, Korra struggles to remain neutral.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Civil Wars Part 2
programme.desc: When Korra's parents are wrongfully arrested, Korra fights for their freedom.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Peacekeepers
programme.desc: When the President of the United Republic refuses to help Korra, she decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Sting
programme.desc: When Triad activity threatens to put Future Industries out of business, Mako performs an investigation and discovers a much bigger conspiracy.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Beginnings Part 1
programme.desc: Korra learns about the epic and mythic origins of the first Avatar.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Beginnings Part 2
programme.desc: Korra delves deeper into the Avatar's past and realizes what she must do in order to restore balance between the physical and spirit worlds.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Guide
programme.desc: Korra seeks Tenzin's help to enter the Spirit World for the first time.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: A New Spiritual Age
programme.desc: Korra enters the Spirit World and struggles with the Avatar's relationship with the spirits.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Night of a Thousand Stars
programme.desc: When President Raiko is attacked, Bolin saves the day.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Harmonic Convergence
programme.desc: Korra and company attempt to close the spirit portals before Harmonic Convergence.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: Darkness Falls
